tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: All blood counts are within or near normal limits, except for a slightly decreased hematocrit and mildly elevated platelet mean volume and distribution width. These findings may suggest mild anisocytosis and platelet activation or regeneration, but there is no evidence of significant anemia, leukocytosis, or thrombocytopenia. No acute hematological abnormality detected; clinical correlation recommended.
